tests.name: json_view_chain_single_escape
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a string with a single unicode escape sequence via json_view.

tests.name: json_view_chain_multiple_escapes
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a chain of unicode escapes generating multi-byte UTF-8 sequences.

tests.name: json_view_chain_mixed_case_hex
tests.intent: Verify parsing of unicode escape chains using mixed-case hexadecimal digits.

tests.name: json_view_chain_long_sequence
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a long chain of unicode escapes to trigger the loop optimization.

tests.name: json_view_chain_followed_by_text
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a unicode escape chain directly followed by regular text characters.

tests.name: json_view_chain_interrupted_by_surrogate
tests.intent: Verify that a surrogate pair in an escape chain safely breaks out of the optimized loop.

tests.name: json_view_chain_interrupted_by_bad_digit
tests.intent: Verify that a malformed hex digit in an escape chain falls back and correctly triggers a parse error.

tests.name: json_view_chain_interrupted_by_cut
tests.intent: Verify that an abruptly truncated input inside an escape chain triggers a parse error.

tests.name: json_view_chain_in_object_key
tests.intent: Verify parsing of unicode escape chains located within object property keys.

tests.name: json_view_chain_ascii_escapes
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a chain of ASCII-range unicode escapes.

tests.name: json_view_chain_zero_codepoint
tests.intent: Verify parsing of unicode escapes generating null characters in a chain.

tests.name: json_view_chain_boundary_six_bytes
tests.intent: Verify parsing behavior when exactly six bytes remain after a unicode escape.

tests.name: json_view_chain_boundary_five_bytes
tests.intent: Verify parsing behavior when fewer than six bytes remain for the subsequent escape.

tests.name: json_view_chain_lone_surrogate_error
tests.intent: Verify that a lone high surrogate inside a chain halts the optimization and raises a correct error.

tests.name: json_view_chain_accept_method
tests.intent: Verify the accept method correctly validates strings containing unicode escape chains.

tests.name: json_view_chain_read_method
tests.intent: Verify the read method on an existing json_document instance correctly handles escape chains.

tests.name: json_view_chain_three_byte_utf8
tests.intent: Verify proper generation of 3-byte UTF-8 characters via unicode escape sequences.

tests.name: json_view_chain_two_byte_utf8
tests.intent: Verify proper generation of 2-byte UTF-8 characters via unicode escape sequences.

tests.name: json_view_chain_multiple_chains_in_array
tests.intent: Verify parsing of an array containing multiple distinct unicode escape chains.

tests.name: json_view_chain_huge_stress
tests.intent: Verify memory handling and parsing correctness for an extremely large escape chain of 3000 items.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercise line 355: a surrogate pair inside a chain of unicode escapes, ensuring the loop correctly breaks out via surrogate detection.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercise line 355: a negative hex_codepoint return value (bad hex digit) inside the loop, forcing a break.

tests.name: gen_28
tests.intent: Exercise line 358: ensure arena capacity expansion (arena_ensure) is successfully invoked when multiple sequential valid unicode escapes are decoded in the loop.

tests.name: gen_29
tests.intent: Exercise lines 355 and 358 together: a valid chain expanding memory via arena_ensure followed by a surrogate break condition.

tests.name: gen_30
tests.intent: Exercise line 358 and 359: a chain of unicode escapes with various valid character code points ensuring put_utf8 and arena_ensure operate correctly across multiple iterations.

tests.name: json_view_chain_huge_stress_fixed
tests.intent: Verify memory handling and parsing correctness for an extremely large escape chain of 3000 items.
